 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It was not a good Week 8 for the Dallas Cowboys. They lost 33-30 in overtime to the Arizona Cardinals, and the NFL announced its punishment for DeMarvion Overshown. It stemmed from an incident that occurred in the second quarter.
 Dallas dropped to 3-5 for the season after losing its third game in last four outings. Dak Prescott led the offense by completing 19-of-29 passes for 195 yards and one touchdown. Javonte Williams spearheaded the backfield's attack with 24 rushes for 56 yards, while CeeDee Lamb powered the receiving corps with seven catches for 58 yards.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Arizona, on the other hand, saw Gardner Minshew taking over under center. He recorded 17-of-23 completions for 188 yards and three touchdowns. Tyler Allgeier shined with 11 rushing attempts for 147 yards and one score.
 Dallas Cowboys linebacker DeMarvion Overshown (0) looks on before the game between the Dallas Cowboys and the Baltimore Ravens at AT&T Stadium.
 NFL Issues Fine on DeMarvion Overshown
 The NFL released its accountability report, including Overshown receiving a $9,258 fine. He was issued the punishment for using his helmet on Cardinals RB Bam Knight during a tackle.
 "The NFL fined Cowboys LB DeMarvion Overshown $9,528 for use of the helmet on this hit that knocked out Cardinals RB Bam Knight last week," Netflix's Tom Pelissero wrote.
 Arizona improved to 3-5 for the season and won its second game in three weeks. The team will return to action on Sunday when they visit the defending Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks, at Lumen Field. FOX will broadcast the Week 9 game live starting at 4:25 p.m. ET.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, Overshown and the Cowboys will travel to Indianapolis for a clash with the Colts at Lucas Oil Stadium. They still have a good chance of winning the NFC East despite having a record below .500. The New York Giants are on top of the division with a 4-2-1 win-loss slate and are the only team with a winning record.
